scope.question: Should the plant commission further checks on the recorded change in energy intensity?
scope.boundary: Whole-site billing and conforming output; same fictional meter
scope.exclusions: No equipment instructions, tariff validity, causal diagnosis or savings verification.
scope.acceptance: Trace every observation to invented sources, reproduce arithmetic, expose limitations and reviewer state.
scope.stopRules: Stop if permission, source verification or qualified review cannot be established. Synthetic demonstration only.
scope.alternative: Fictional plant team manually compares records; actual buyer alternative not yet interviewed.
scope.residualGap: Hypothesis only: source reconciliation may clarify the next investigation decision. Buyer validation pending.
